title: KCS U3c (e) RUN: the ansatz-family SCREEN on the seven recorded residual points (mechanism step, no new sieving) - inverse-variance weighted fits of R(X) = meas - u3 over 1e7..1e11 against the 7-member loglog-scale family {delta, (loglog/log)^2, (loglog/log)^3, loglog/log, 1/log, 1/log^2, floor}. Findings: (1) NO single-component form survives (best: 1/log^2, max resid 3.67 se) - consistent with the 0173-0187 record; (2) 19 of 21 two-component pairs pass the screening bar (max|resid| <= 3 se AND chi2 <= 2*dof) - the residual law is a TWO-COMPONENT structure over this ladder, with the 1/log^2 scale in 6 of the top-10 pairs (best pair: 1/log^2 + floor, chi2 = 3.17 / 5 dof, max 1.45 se); (3) three-component fits reach chi2 = 2.76-3.00 / 4 dof (flagged overfit zone: 7 points cannot discriminate among the ~20 compatible 2-param families - the discriminator points 3e11/1e12 are beyond this box's memory, named in 0187); (4) the 0187 growing excess e(X) = +6.68e-04/+8.32e-04/+9.99e-04 at 1e10/3e10/1e11 is consistent with ONE power of loglog X, k = 4.23 over the full span (pair slopes 4.72/3.75), with the middle point predicted through-the-ends within 2.3% - the 'slowly growing excess' is a ~(loglog X)^4.2 hint (2-3 point, not a law), not a constant floor (the growth exceeds the floor-fit spread). Verdict: the mechanism is narrowed to 'decaying loglog-log component (dominated by 1/log^2 scale) + growing ~(loglog X)^4.2 component'; the strict-CI gate stays OPEN (needs a DERIVED correction, e.g. the next-order product term delta*(loglog/log) of the LOS expansion - named as U3c (f)). No RH claim: prime-gap class census residual over exact integers; flank, not face.
claim: This is the U3c mechanism step ('derive the transfer mechanism'), run as a pure-arithmetic screen on the SEVEN recorded residual points (1e7/1e8/3e8/1e9 from 0170/0171/0173, 1e10 from 0186, 3e10/1e11 from 0187 - no new sieving, all values from the record). Method: inverse-variance weighted least squares (weights 1/se^2; residuals reported in se units; chi2 with dof = n - params). Family F = {f1 = delta (the verified LOS q=4 factor), f2 = (loglog/log)^2, f3 = (loglog/log)^3, f4 = loglog/log, f5 = 1/log, f6 = 1/log^2, f7 = 1 (a possible floor)}. Results: (1) single-component: all 7 fail the 3-se bar; best f6 = 1/log^2 at max 3.67 se (f2 = 4.61, f3 = 4.41, f5 = 9.25, f1 = 12.76, f4 = 13.25, f7 = 21.93) - confirming the earlier single-form kills on the full ladder in one table; (2) two-component: 19 of 21 pairs pass (max <= 3 se, chi2 <= 10); the passing families cluster around the 1/log^2 scale - f6 appears in 6 of the top-10 pairs; best pair f6 + floor chi2 = 3.17 (5 dof) max 1.45 se, then f4 + f6 (3.20), f1 + f6 (3.21), f5 + f6 (3.27); the two non-passing pairs are both floor-pairs (f1 + f7 chi2 13.62, f4 + f7 chi2 14.84) - the floor alone cannot carry the data; (3) three-component: top triples at chi2 2.76-3.00 / 4 dof (e.g. f1 + f2 + f5, f2 + f4 + f5) - statistically excellent but in the explicit overfit zone: with 7 points of which the first two carry the loosest se, a 3-param family passes almost trivially; this table is recorded as 'compatible', not 'chosen'; (4) the 0187 excess structure: e(X) = R(X) - pred4(X) at 1e10/3e10/1e11 fits e ~ A*(loglog X)^k with pair-slope k = 4.720 (1e10-3e10), 3.752 (3e10-1e11), full-span 4.225; the through-the-ends power predicts the middle point +0.000813 vs measured +0.000832 (2.3% of the excess) - the three excess points are mutually consistent with a single loglog power around k = 4, and the constant-floor test fails in the direction of GROWTH (spread -1.65e-4/-0.1e-6/+1.66e-4 around the mean). The honest mechanism statement over the full 1e7..1e11 ladder: R(X) consists of a decaying loglog-log component (the 1/log^2 scale fits best among the tested decays) plus a slowly GROWING excess of the form ~(loglog X)^4.2 (2-3 point hint). What this is NOT: the screen does not select a unique law (19 families pass; 7 points cannot do the discrimination - that power belongs to 3e11/1e12, beyond this box per 0187), it does not close the plan's strict-CI gate (which requires a DERIVED, not fitted, correction landing inside CI), and it makes no RH claim (R is a prime-gap class census residual over exact integers; the zeta-side inputs are the named model channels of the U3 machinery). Named next step (U3c (f)): extend the family with the DERIVED next-order candidate delta(X)*(loglog X/log X) (the first product term of the LOS expansion) and re-screen - the test of whether the transfer's next term is a product term or the bare loglog-power excess. Cost: seconds, no compute, no memory. Output: tmp/kcs3c_e_out.txt.
evidence: scripts/rh/kcs3c_e_ansatz_sweep.py: the 7-point record table (X, R, se from 0170/0171/0173/0186/0187), the 7-member family F, inverse-variance OLS (Gauss + pivoting), the single/two/three-component screens with the screening bar stated, the 0187 excess power fits, the screening verdict; a units bug in the first run (weighted residual computed as raw/sqrt(se) instead of raw/se, understating every misfit by ~sqrt(se)) was caught by sanity-checking the magnitudes and fixed before the record (the buggy run's 'chi2 = 0.00 across the board' is the telltale)

tmp/kcs3c_e_out.txt: the full screen - all 21 pairs and the top-5 triples with chi2 / max|resid| / coefficients; 19 pair survivors; the excess power fits (k = 4.720/3.752/4.225, middle-point check +2.3e-5 deviation); the explicit overfit-zone flag on the triples

record-consistency: the 7 points and their se are exactly the 0170/0171/0173/0186/0187 record values (no resieving); the 0186 4-pt-anchored mixed prediction (a = -0.123764, b = 0.715792) is reused verbatim for the excess definition

cross-check: the single-form failures re-derive the earlier kills (0173: C not constant; 0186: alpha power law dead; 0187: mixed under-predicts) in one weighted table - the three separate earlier statements are the same finding seen at different stages
